subject.title: Redesign publish plugin & skill empty states

question: Should the publish pages hide skill/plugin metadata until files are selected, or preserve the existing pre-upload form contract while polishing the empty states?
rationale: The PR changes the user-visible publishing workflow and the existing local-auth automation contract, so automation should not choose the permanent UX direction.

options.title: Adopt upload-first after repairs
options.body: Keep the progressive-disclosure direction, then require local-auth helper/test updates and real branch proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve pre-upload form contract
options.body: Ask for narrower copy/layout polish that keeps metadata and rights controls present before upload.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged until maintainers decide whether hiding pre-upload metadata is desirable for publishing.

recommendation.title: Adopt upload-first after repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the progressive-disclosure direction, then require local-auth helper/test updates and real branch proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is most directly tied to the current publish workflow and local-auth helper contract in recent merged history.
